hook.text: AN APOLOGY, FROM A PTE TRAINER

textBlocks.text: Dear PTE aspirants, the industry owes you an apology.
You were told to improve your English. But you already: ✓ speak fluent English ✓ work in English every day ✓ still score 55-65 in speaking
textBlocks.role: recognition checklist — the reader's own facts

textBlocks.text: Your English was never the problem. PTE is scored by a machine, and the machine rewards a format. Last batch, one student walked out with a 90/90 — the Pearson report is on our page.
This Saturday, I'll show you the format. All 22 task types. Four hours. — Parthasarathy Bhaskara, Pearson-certified trainer
P.S. If you've booked a retake already — come before you sit it. The seat is ₹589; a retake is ₹18,000.
